purpose: Index and retrieve AETHIEAOPSYS receipts, topology, routes, services, software audits, endpoint audits, and domain bindings without collapsing authority into the VPS.
authority_rule: VRAG retrieves and reasons over indexed corpus material. VRAG does not become source-of-truth.
source_of_truth_rule: Receipts, configs, committed files, and operator locks remain controlling record.
privacy_rule: No keys, tokens, credentials, cert bodies, or private auth material enter the index.
